blurb: Guests take helicopter tours departing from Gillespie Field, flying over San Diego's coastal and inland landmarks including beaches, downtown, and luxury estates. Tours range from 30 to 60 minutes, showcasing views of places like MCAS Miramar, La Jolla Cove, Mission Bay, and the Coronado Bridge. Private charters are also available from multiple Southern California airports.
